facts.fact: WordStream/LocaliQ's 2026 US search median cost per click for Google Ads is $5.42, as reported by Digital Applied.
facts.quote: WordStream/LocaliQ’s US search medians were $5.42 per click, an 8.18% conversion rate and $66.69 per lead.

facts.fact: Attorneys and legal services had a median Google Ads cost per click of $9.87 in the cited benchmark data.
facts.quote: Attorneys and legal services had a median of $9.87 per click.

facts.fact: Alphabet reported that Google Search cost per click rose 3% year on year in Q2 2026.
facts.quote: Alphabet reported Google Search cost per click up 3% year on year in Q2 2026, a smaller rise than the 12.88% in WordStream’s 2025 edition.

facts.fact: WordStream's 2025 edition reported a 12.88% rise in Google Search cost per click.
facts.quote: a smaller rise than the 12.88% in WordStream’s 2025 edition.

facts.fact: WordStream/LocaliQ's 2026 Facebook data gives a US median cost per click of $0.60 for traffic campaigns, covering April 2025 to June 2026.
facts.quote: the median for US traffic campaigns was $0.60 per click.

facts.fact: WordStream/LocaliQ's 2026 Facebook data gives a US median of $1.80 per click and $27.39 per lead for lead campaigns.
facts.quote: Lead campaigns had a median of $1.80 per click and $27.39 per lead.

facts.fact: Coupler.io's roundup of the same benchmarks reports that Facebook traffic cost per click fell 14.29% while cost per lead stayed flat.
facts.quote: notes that the traffic CPC fell 14.29% while cost per lead stayed flat.

facts.fact: Meta reported its average price per ad rose 12% in Q2 2026, a company-wide pricing measure rather than a CPC or CPM.
facts.quote: Meta also reported its average price per ad up 12% in Q2 2026.

facts.fact: In Moonb's 2026 commercial cost guide, a simple local TV spot costs $1,500 to $10,000 to produce.
facts.quote: a simple local spot costs $1,500 to $10,000 to produce.

facts.fact: The IAB's 2026 outlook forecasts 13.8% growth in US connected TV ad spend in 2026, up from 11.4% in 2025; this is a forecast from a buy-side decision-maker survey, not measured spending.
facts.quote: forecasts 13.8% growth in US CTV ad spend in 2026, up from 11.4% in 2025.

facts.fact: WordStream's Google Ads benchmarks for 2026 were last updated September 16, 2026, according to the page.
facts.quote: WordStream’s [Google Ads benchmarks for 2026](https://www.wordstream.com/blog/2026-google-ads-benchmarks) were last updated September 16, 2026.

facts.fact: Adwave's published pricing threshold for the core channel mix (Streaming TV, YouTube, Google Search, Facebook, Instagram, mobile web and apps) is a $30 daily budget.
facts.quote: $30 a day | Streaming TV, YouTube, Google Search, Facebook, Instagram, mobile web and apps

facts.fact: According to Adwave's published pricing thresholds, Reddit is added to the channel mix at about a $35 daily budget.
Adwave charges $6 for an optional extra 15-second TV spot creative; campaign creative is otherwise included in the cost.
facts.quote: Extra creative is optional: $6 for a 15-second TV spot and $12 for a 30-second spot.

facts.fact: Adwave states it has no subscription; its daily budget is an all-in price covering media, ads, and management.
facts.quote: There is no subscription, and the daily budget is an all-in price covering media, ads, and management.

facts.fact: Adwave places campaigns through its own connected advertising accounts, so the customer does not need to open separate accounts.
facts.quote: Adwave places campaigns through its own connected advertising accounts, so you don’t need to open separate ones.

facts.fact: The article uses an example cost per click of $0.60 for a Facebook click and $5.42 for a search click to illustrate why cost per click comparisons across channels can mislead.
facts.quote: Comparing a $0.60 Facebook click with a $5.42 search click misleads in the same way
